correctness.rationale: For every n>=4 and theta>0, deletion of a prescribed fixed label retains Ewens theta on n-1 labels; exact q_n is derived by two-arrow weight enumeration. Conditioning yields (n-2)q_{n-1} at endpoints and (n-3)q_{n-1}+(n-1)/(theta+n-2) at interior positions. Combining with p_n=theta/(theta+n-1) and E D=(n-1)q_n gives the stated rational formulas. Positive denominators, positive P,Q, and positive global residual polynomial establish complete sign classification. The leading polynomial orders prove fixed-theta asymptotics. Independent exact-rational permutation enumeration n=4..8, theta in {1/3,1/2,1,2,5}, passed. Finite checks supplement unrestricted algebraic proof.

value.rationale: Fixed points and descents are natural statistics in a classically studied conjugation-invariant law; negative total covariance does not determine the sign for individual labels. The exact phase theta=1, surprising positive interior effects for theta<1, and different 1/n versus 1/n² asymptotic orders resolve a structural dependence question with no arbitrary parameter slice or numerical guesswork.
